subject.title: fix(gateway): bound connect frame auth.* fields at the protocol schema

question: Should connect-frame auth fields be bounded at the protocol schema with byte/shape validation, and should runtime-token fields be included in this PR?
rationale: This is valid pre-auth security hardening, but it changes the public gateway protocol validation boundary and the current implementation does not enforce the byte work limit it claims.

options.title: Fix byte caps and cover all fields
options.body: Require byte-length or ASCII token-shape enforcement plus direct tests/proof for all six capped auth fields before merge.

options.title: Narrow to bootstrap/device tokens
options.body: Keep the proven iterated-token DoS mitigation here and leave shared/runtime token caps for a separately justified protocol decision.

options.title: Accept current partial hardening
options.body: Gateway/security owners may intentionally accept grapheme-count caps and runtime-token caps as a known compatibility tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Fix byte caps and cover all fields
recommendation.body: Require byte-length or ASCII token-shape enforcement plus direct tests/proof for all six capped auth fields before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The gateway auth/security history and recent adjacent merge make this the best available owner for the protocol boundary choice.
